subject: HELP: Active water leak in kitchen
body: Hi Cascade team, there is water actively spraying from the pipe beneath our kitchen sink. I turned off the valve, but we have water on the floor. What are your emergency dispatch rates and how fast can someone get here?
draft_response:
Hi there,

First, please take a deep breath—you did an amazing job turning off that shut-off valve! That is exactly the right first step to prevent further damage, and you've handled it perfectly.

Since you have an active leak, we want to help you get this resolved as quickly and stress-free as possible. Our 24/7 emergency dispatch service is available right now. We have an $85 flat call-out fee, plus parts and labor, and our technician will provide you with a clear, upfront estimate on site before starting any work.

To get a professional plumber dispatched to your home immediately, please call us directly at (555) 111-2222 so we can fast-track your dispatch. You can also instantly secure an urgent slot using our scheduling link: https://calendly.com/cascade-plumbing-scheduling

Hang in there, we've got you covered! We'll get your kitchen sorted out and dry in no time.

Warmly,

The Cascade Plumbing Team

subject: Requesting quote for tankless water heater
